region.why: a deployment fact: HCAZERRS ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; the corpus names no region

notes: The example-health-apis medication-inquire front end HCM1BI01, LINKed with a COMMAREA: after the length checks it LINKs HCIMDB01 (which loads the MEDICATION rows) and RETURNs. A patient with two or more rows is not driven: LOAD-COMMAREA stores entry n after setting CA-NUM-MEDICATIONS to n-1, a subscript past the ODO count that IBM (no SSRANGE) leaves undefined and GnuCOBOL refuses (register X8). Tables come from the estate's @DB2CRE.jcl (HCZMSA1). Derived from IBM's example-health-apis (github.com/ibm/example-health-apis, Apache-2.0; (C) Copyright IBM Corp. 2011, 2014): LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived.

scenarios.name: found
scenarios.why: patient 3 has one MEDICATION row: OPEN-CURSOR loads it (the caller's area holds 50 entries), then FETCH is 100 with ws-counter > 0, '00'

scenarios.name: not-found
scenarios.why: no MEDICATION row for patient 9: the first FETCH is SQLCODE 100, CA-RETURN-CODE '01', RETURN

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE (LINK HCAZERRS) then ABEND HCCA

scenarios.name: short-commarea
scenarios.why: one byte under the 18-byte header: '98' to CA-RETURN-CODE, RETURN before any SELECT

scenarios.name: frequency-1
scenarios.why: patient 4 has one MEDICATION row whose frequency is '1': HCIMDB01 loads it and EVALUATE CA-FREQUENCY takes WHEN 1 (every 24 hours)

scenarios.name: not-found-zero-count
scenarios.why: no MEDICATION row for patient 9 and the caller's count is 0: nothing is loaded, so CA-NUM-MEDICATIONS > 0 is false and the frequency loop is skipped
